Control_Statement: Ensure compute engine instances do not possess public external IP addresses
Control_Description: Enforces total perimeter isolation by restricting server execution environments strictly to private network spaces.

Control_Statement: Ensure all cloud storage buckets have uniform bucket-level access enabled
Control_Description: Prevents accidental granular object leaks by forcing permission definitions exclusively to IAM control structures.

Control_Statement: Ensure cloud SQL database instances enforce encrypted SSL connections for all inbound traffic
Control_Description: Eliminates cleartext network sniffing vectors by mandating transport layer security for database interactions.

Control_Statement: Ensure the default network is completely deleted across all corporate projects
Control_Description: Eliminates broad default firewall openings and unmanaged routing assumptions from standard workspace templates.

Control_Statement: Ensure cloud storage buckets do not permit anonymous or public unauthenticated read permissions
Control_Description: Guarantees proprietary customer application documentation and statements remain closed to the public internet.

Control_Statement: Ensure API keys are automatically rotated every 90 days or less
Control_Description: Mitigates long-term credential leakage risks by establishing deterministic secret lifetimes.

Control_Statement: Ensure log storage buckets reside in a distinct compliance-governed cloud project
Control_Description: Isolates the operational audit footprint from production infrastructure environments to mitigate insider threats.

Control_Statement: Ensure no firewall rules permit unauthenticated ingress traffic from the public internet to port 22
Control_Description: Shields administrative shell boundaries by blocking global SSH scanner sweeps from reaching host assets.

Control_Statement: Ensure compute disk snapshots are retained for less than 30 days unless legal hold is active
Control_Description: Minimizes legacy shadow data footprints to limit liability in the event of an environment storage breach.

Control_Statement: Ensure object lifecycle management policies are configured to transition data to archival storage
Control_Description: Automates financial record lifecycle obligations while ensuring unneeded warm files are aged out safely.

Control_Statement: Ensure separation of duties is enforced between project creators and resource managers
Control_Description: Maintains structural financial regulatory governance by ensuring distinct operators authorize infrastructure drift.

Control_Statement: Ensure corporate domain restricted sharing policies are enabled on all organization nodes
Control_Description: Enforces data sovereignty boundaries by blocking external identities from obtaining IAM permissions.

Control_Statement: Ensure alerting configurations are established for project IAM policy changes
Control_Description: Triggers immediate security operations response workflows whenever authorization structures are manipulated.

Control_Statement: Ensure cloud resource manager metadata does not contain sensitive static credentials
Control_Description: Prevents accidental environment credential exposures by shifting authentication materials out of text metadata variables.

Control_Statement: Ensure database instance root user passwords are rotated dynamically via automated secrets managers
Control_Description: Limits credential reuse risks by removing static root master credentials from the operational equation.
